note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 5.1.5 ("A BGP speaker SHALL calculate the degree of preference for each external route based on the locally-configured policy, and include the degree of preference when advertising a route to its internal peers."). Positive: TestRFC4271ExternalRouteDegreeOfPreferenceFromLocalPolicy proves extractCandidate seeds external routes with default preference 100; TestRFC4271ExternalRoutePreferenceFromPolicyReachesRIBAndInternalPeers proves an external route with no received LOCAL_PREF gets LOCAL_PREF 200 from import policy on dispatch to RIB and reaches an internal peer with LOCAL_PREF 200 (and external peer with none). Negative: TestRFC4271DegreeOfPreferenceNotAHardcodedConstant proves received LOCAL_PREF 250 overrides the 100 default; TestRFC4271ExternalRouteWithoutPolicyStillAdvertisesAPreferenceInternally proves an external route with no policy carries no LOCAL_PREF to RIB yet still advertises default LOCAL_PREF 100 internally.
